related_questions.question: Are COVID-19 vaccines still necessary?
related_questions.snippet: CDC recommends a 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine for most adults ages 18 and older. Parents of children ages 6 months to 17 years should discuss the benefits of vaccination with a healthcare provider. The COVID-19 vaccine helps protect you from severe illness, hospitalization, and death.
